title: 68万行代码一天内完成迁移
title_en: 680K-line migration in under a day
summary: Anthropic 发布稿称，一位早期测试者用 Opus 5.5 在不到一天内完成了 68 万行代码迁移。
summary_en: Anthropic's launch post claims an early tester completed a 680,000-line code migration with Opus 5.5 in under a day.
author: Anthropic

title: HAProxy 从 C 改写为 Rust
title_en: HAProxy C-to-Rust translation
summary: 官方称 Opus 5.5 用 9.5 小时将 HAProxy 从 C 翻译为 Rust 并通过回归测试，比 Fable 5.1（12 小时）更快、成本低 51%。
summary_en: Anthropic says Opus 5.5 translated HAProxy from C to Rust in 9.5 hours passing regression tests, faster than Fable 5.1 (12h) at 51% lower cost.
author: Anthropic

title: 并购分析：Excel 建模+高管演示
title_en: Merger analysis: Excel model + exec deck
summary: 官方测试中 Opus 5.5 为两家虚构 HR 软件公司并购构建 Excel 财务模型并制作高管演示，用时 63 分钟（Opus 5 为 93 分钟），成本低 50%，错误更少。
summary_en: In Anthropic's test Opus 5.5 built an Excel merger model and exec presentation in 63 min vs 93 for Opus 5, at 50% lower cost and with fewer errors.
author: Anthropic

title: Stripe：40 个堆叠 PR 的多日变基
title_en: Stripe: multi-day rebase of 40 stacked PRs
summary: Stripe 工程师称 Opus 5.5 在单次会话中协调完成 40 个堆叠 PR 的多日变基，全部通过 CI。
summary_en: A Stripe engineer says Opus 5.5 handled a multi-day rebase of 40 stacked pull requests in one session, with all 40 passing CI.
author: Stripe (Cristian Rivera)

title: Quantium：38 次提示降至 11 次
title_en: Quantium: 38 prompts down to 11
summary: Quantium 称一项此前需 4 天、38 次提示的复杂编码任务，用 Opus 5.5 只需 11 次提示。
summary_en: Quantium says a complex coding task that took 38 prompts over four days came in at 11 prompts with Opus 5.5.
author: Quantium (Harley Barnes)

title: Deloitte：低思考档代码审查找出 72% 已知缺陷
title_en: Deloitte: 72% bug catch at lowest effort
summary: Deloitte 称 Opus 5.5 在最低 effort 下即可在代码审查中发现 72% 的已知缺陷，而 Opus 5 高档为 56%，误报更少。
summary_en: Deloitte reports Opus 5.5 at lowest effort caught 72% of known bugs in code reviews vs 56% for Opus 5 at high effort, with fewer false alarms.
author: Deloitte Consulting LLP

title: Hebbia：金融工作流覆盖率 86.6%
title_en: Hebbia: 86.6% rubric coverage on finance workflows
summary: Hebbia 称在专家评分的端到端金融工作流中，Opus 5.5 覆盖 86.6% 的目标标准，Opus 5 为 60.3%。
summary_en: Hebbia reports Opus 5.5 covered 86.6% of expert rubric criteria on end-to-end finance workflows vs 60.3% for Opus 5.
author: Hebbia (Aabhas Sharma)

title: Walleye Capital：发现评测中的索引错误
title_en: Walleye Capital: caught an indexing error in its eval
summary: Walleye Capital 称 Opus 5.5 发现了其评测任务中的一个索引错误，此前没有模型发现过。
summary_en: Walleye Capital says Opus 5.5 detected an indexing error in their evaluation that no previous model had caught.
author: Walleye Capital (Frank Corrao)

title: Optiver：交易支持任务成本降 40-50%
title_en: Optiver: 40-50% cost cut on trading-support suite
summary: Optiver 称 Opus 5.5 在其交易支持测试集上得分最高，同时成本降低 40% 至 50%。
summary_en: Optiver reports the highest score on its trading-support suite with a 40–50% cost reduction.
author: Optiver (Noyan Tokgozoglu)

title: Chicago Trading Company：夜间自主修复 bug
title_en: Chicago Trading Company: overnight autonomous bug fix
summary: CTC 工程师称 Opus 5.5 自主处理一个 bug，第二天早上修改已完成并通过测试。
summary_en: A CTC engineer says Opus 5.5 autonomously handled a bug; by morning the change was done and passing.
author: Chicago Trading Company (Austen Tomek)

title: LexisNexis：法律引证检索
title_en: LexisNexis: legal citation retrieval
summary: LexisNexis 称 Opus 5.5 能稳定找出高度相关的引证，擅长成文法并围绕核心法律框架组织回答。
summary_en: LexisNexis says Opus 5.5 consistently identified highly relevant citations, was strong on statutes, and structured answers around key legal frameworks.
author: LexisNexis (Min Chen)

title: 季度报告写作：18 份中 16 份达标
title_en: Quarterly reports: 16/18 cleared quality bar
summary: 官方称在需核查来源的公司季度报告写作测试中，Opus 5.5 有 16/18 份达到质量标准，Fable 5.1 与 Opus 5 均未达标。
summary_en: Anthropic says in a source-verified quarterly report writing test, 16 of 18 Opus 5.5 reports cleared the quality bar while Fable 5.1 and Opus 5 did not.
author: Anthropic

title: OSWorld 2.0 电脑操作 81.8%
title_en: OSWorld 2.0 computer use 81.8%
summary: 官方公布 Opus 5.5 在 OSWorld 2.0 电脑操作基准上得 81.8%，高于 Opus 5（74.0%）和 Fable 5.1（80.7%）。
summary_en: Anthropic reports 81.8% on OSWorld 2.0 computer-use tasks, above Opus 5 (74.0%) and Fable 5.1 (80.7%).
author: Anthropic

title: Terminal-Bench-Science 科研代理 58.7%
title_en: Terminal-Bench-Science agentic research 58.7%
summary: 官方称 Opus 5.5 在代理式科研基准 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 上得 58.7%，Opus 5 为 29.0%。
summary_en: Anthropic reports 58.7% on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 (agentic scientific research) vs 29.0% for Opus 5.
author: Anthropic

title: Box：企业多文档任务 token 降至三分之一
title_en: Box: enterprise multi-document tasks at 1/3 tokens
summary: Box 在跨表格、PDF、演示文稿的企业任务上测试，Opus 5.5 比 Opus 5 快 30%、token 约为三分之一、输出短 42%，技术行业准确率 63%→74%。
summary_en: Box tested multi-document enterprise tasks: Opus 5.5 was 30% faster, used ~1/3 the tokens, 42% shorter output; technology-task accuracy rose 63%→74%.
author: Box (Aditi Tuli)

title: GitHub Copilot 集成 Opus 5.5
title_en: Opus 5.5 in GitHub Copilot
summary: GitHub 宣布 Opus 5.5 上线 Copilot，称早期测试中以更少步骤和 token 完成任务，并能快速从多步任务错误中恢复。
summary_en: GitHub made Opus 5.5 available in Copilot, saying it solved tasks with fewer steps and tokens and recovered quickly from errors in multistep tasks.
author: GitHub

title: Cursor：CursorBench 57.8% 登顶
title_en: Cursor: tops CursorBench at 57.8%
summary: Cursor 文档称 Opus 5.5 以 57.8% 成为 CursorBench 最高分模型，单任务成本比 Opus 5 低 40%。
summary_en: Cursor docs say Opus 5.5 is the top CursorBench model at 57.8% and costs 40% less per task than Opus 5.
author: Cursor

title: AWS Bedrock 上线及成本估算示例
title_en: Available on AWS Bedrock with cost-estimate example
summary: AWS 博客介绍 Opus 5.5 上线 Bedrock，并以估算 40TB/月 S3 出口流量成本和优化架构作为示例任务。
summary_en: AWS announced Opus 5.5 on Bedrock, using an example of estimating S3 egress cost for 40 TB/month and proposing an architecture optimization.
author: AWS

title: CodeRabbit：代码审查召回率小幅提升但 token 增加
title_en: CodeRabbit: small recall gain, more tokens
summary: CodeRabbit 测试显示 Opus 5.5 标准档在 80 个开源缺陷模式中发现 51 个（63.8%），略高于基线，但 token 用量增加约 49%，更高 effort 未必更好。
summary_en: CodeRabbit found Opus 5.5 Standard caught 51/80 OSS bug patterns (63.8%) vs 61.3% baseline, but used ~49% more tokens; higher effort did not consistently help.
author: CodeRabbit (Hendrik Krack, Gowtham Kishore Vijay)

title: Every 实测：Ruby 基准、3D 场景与局限
title_en: Every vibe check: Ruby bench, 3D scene, failures
summary: Every 团队测试 Ruby 性能基准、心率监测应用、Cozy Island 3D 场景等，3D 场景胜过 Fable；但品牌模板 PPT 出现错误 logo 和颜色，训练计划任务超时未交付。
summary_en: Every tested a Ruby benchmark, webcam heart-rate app and Cozy Island 3D scene (beat Fable), but a branded PPT had wrong logo/colors and a training plan task timed out.
author: Every (Katie Parrott, Kieran Klaassen, Mike Taylor)

title: Every：用 Enron 邮件分析欺诈话术传播
title_en: Every: tracing fraud jargon in Enron emails
summary: Every 的 Mike Taylor 让 Opus 5.5 分析 Enron 邮件中的欺诈性术语传播路径，表现与 Fable 相当。
summary_en: Mike Taylor at Every had Opus 5.5 trace the spread of fraud-related jargon through Enron emails; it matched Fable's performance.
author: Every (Mike Taylor)

title: Simon Willison：max 档画鹈鹕 SVG 耗尽 token
title_en: Simon Willison: max effort exhausts tokens on pelican SVG
summary: Simon Willison 用“骑自行车的鹈鹕”SVG 测试，max 档两次推理耗尽 128k 输出 token 未产出结果（每次 2.56 美元、近 20 分钟），他认为 max 档实用性存疑。
summary_en: Simon Willison's pelican-on-bicycle SVG at max effort hit the 128k output cap twice without output ($2.56, ~20 min each); he called max effectively useless.
author: Simon Willison

title: PlayCode：MacBook SVG 基准性价比最佳
title_en: PlayCode: best value on MacBook SVG benchmark
summary: PlayCode 的 MacBook Pro SVG 基准中，Opus 5.5 xhigh 以 1.72 美元生成含菜单栏和 Dock 的细致图像，约为 Fable 5.1 成本三分之一；max 档在流式 API 上耗尽 token。PlayCode 已将其设为默认模型。
summary_en: On PlayCode's MacBook SVG benchmark, Opus 5.5 xhigh produced a detailed laptop render for $1.72 (~1/3 of Fable 5.1); max exhausted the streaming token cap. PlayCode made it the default model.
author: PlayCode (Ian Berdin)

title: 单提示生成 RTS/体素/飞行模拟游戏
title_en: One-prompt RTS, voxel and flight-sim games
summary: Senko Rašić 的 vibecode-bench 中，Opus 5.5 在 Claude Code xhigh 下用约 45 分钟、11-14 美元生成可玩的 RTS、类 Minecraft 与飞行模拟游戏，作者认为与 Fable 5.1 相当甚至更好。
summary_en: In Senko Rašić's vibecode-bench, Opus 5.5 (xhigh, Claude Code) built playable RTS, voxel and flight-sim games in ~45 min for $11–14 each, on par with or better than Fable 5.1.
author: Senko Rašić

title: PartForge：CAD 建模任务得分最高
title_en: PartForge: top score on hard CAD tasks
summary: PartForge 在 26 个高难 CAD 任务上测试，Opus 5.5 总分最高、58% 全部通过检查、耗时约为 Opus 5 三分之一；但因单次成功成本和长时间无反馈，默认仍用 Gemini Flash。
summary_en: PartForge's 26 hard CAD tasks: Opus 5.5 posted the best overall score (58% passed all checks, ~1/3 the time of Opus 5), but they kept Gemini Flash as default due to cost per solve and silent waits.
author: PartForge

title: 用子代理识读 1819 年博斯普鲁斯古地图
title_en: Reading an 1819 Bosphorus map with subagents
summary: 开发者用 Claude Code 主代理调度 Opus 5.5 子代理，将古地图切成 54 块，一个下午识读并翻译 387 个地名标签，生成可搜索网页应用，仍需人工核对。
summary_en: A developer orchestrated Opus 5.5 subagents over 54 map tiles to read and translate 387 labels from an 1819 French Bosphorus map in an afternoon, with human verification still required.
author: Cahid Arda Öz

title: HAQQ 法律基准：与 Fable 质量难分高下
title_en: HAQQ legal benchmark: quality tie, half the price
summary: HAQQ 用 10 个律师级任务、120 个盲评判决测试，Opus 5.5、Fable 5.1、Opus 5 质量难分伯仲，但 Opus 5.5 单次回答成本约为 Fable 5.1 一半。
summary_en: HAQQ's 10 lawyer-grade prompts and 120 blind verdicts found Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Opus 5 interchangeable on quality, with Opus 5.5 at about half Fable's cost.
author: HAQQ

title: Vals AI：总榜第一但法律代理任务薄弱
title_en: Vals AI: #1 index, weak on agentic legal
summary: Vals AI 显示 Opus 5.5 以 69.69% 位列 Vals Index 第一，但在 Harvey 法律代理基准仅得 3.75%（第 31 名）。
summary_en: Vals AI ranks Opus 5.5 #1 on the Vals Index (69.69%) but it scored only 3.75% (#31) on Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark.
author: Vals AI

title: NTT DATA：Bedrock 上压缩 6 万 token 至 407
title_en: NTT DATA: compaction 60K→407 tokens on Bedrock
summary: NTT DATA 工程师在 AWS Bedrock 上实测 Opus 5.5 上下文压缩，将约 6 万 token 压到 407 token，同时发现 max_tokens 不足等情况下压缩会静默失败。
summary_en: An NTT DATA engineer measured Opus 5.5 compaction on Bedrock shrinking ~60K tokens to 407, and found silent failures when e.g. max_tokens was too low.
author: Yutaka Kashiwabara (NTT DATA)

title: Qiita：360 次自测对比推理与编码
title_en: Qiita: 360-run reasoning & coding comparison
summary: 作者自建 24 道题跑 360 次，Opus 5.5 high 在难推理题得 24/27；medium 档编码每题约 40 秒、0.23 美元，而 Opus 5 为 189 秒、0.82 美元。
summary_en: The author ran 360 trials on 24 self-made tasks: Opus 5.5 high scored 24/27 on hard reasoning; medium coding took ~40s/$0.23 per task vs 189s/$0.82 for Opus 5.
author: Takuya

title: note：3D 弹珠轨道、格斗游戏等演示
title_en: note: 3D marble run, fighting game demos
summary: 日本博主用 Opus 5.5 生成偶像落地页、Notion 风编辑器、迷你 Figma、3D 弹珠轨道与格斗游戏等，称弹珠物理明显改善、token 消耗低于 Fable 5.1。
summary_en: A Japanese blogger generated an idol landing page, Notion-style editor, mini Figma, 3D marble run and fighting game, noting better physics and lower token use than Fable 5.1.
author: まさお (masa_wunder)

title: note：整理约 1000 个文件并检查 API 密钥
title_en: note: sorting ~1,000 files and checking for API keys
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 创建 Discord 频道、将约 1000 个文件分入 5 类并检查混入的 API 密钥，任务不中断完成（作者说明为主观体验）。
summary_en: The author had Opus 5.5 set up a Discord room, sort ~1,000 files into 5 categories and check for leaked API keys, completing without stopping (self-described impressions).
author: アライ (Arai)

title: 新智元：纯代码复刻阿波罗 8 号“地出”
title_en: Recreating Apollo 8 'Earthrise' purely in code
summary: 新智元报道开发者用 Opus 5.5 以代码和公开数据复刻“地出”照片、生成黑洞科普动画，并用 Python 做风格迁移，称“大模型开始吞噬多模态”。
summary_en: Xinzhiyuan reports developers used Opus 5.5 to recreate the Apollo 8 'Earthrise' photo from code and public data, make a black-hole explainer animation, and do Python style transfer.
author: 新智元

title: 手绘投石机草图生成 3D 物理仿真
title_en: Catapult sketch to interactive 3D physics sim
summary: 搜狐转载报道称 DeepMind 研究者 Ben Poole 输入手绘投石机草图，Opus 5.5 生成结构吻合、可交互的 3D 物理仿真。
summary_en: A Sohu report says DeepMind researcher Ben Poole fed a hand-drawn catapult sketch and Opus 5.5 generated a matching interactive 3D physics simulation.
author: Ben Poole (via Sohu)

title: 国内博主实测：重构 Python 项目与合同风险提取
title_en: Chinese blogger: Python refactor and contract risk extraction
summary: 博主在 Claude Pro 中用 Opus 5.5 重构中型 Python 项目、从数十页 PDF 合同中提取风险条款，称重点前置、格式一次到位。
summary_en: A Chinese blogger used Opus 5.5 to refactor a mid-size Python project and extract risk clauses from a long PDF contract, noting key points up front.
author: littlemagic8

title: Theo Browne：6.5 小时代理会话与前端短板
title_en: Theo Browne: 6.5-hour agent session, weaker design taste
summary: 报道称 Theo Browne 测试了 6.5 小时代理会话、电脑操作抓取数据和 120FPS 3D 游戏，medium 档性价比高，但前端设计品味弱于 Fable 5.1、max 档算力翻 10 倍仅提升约 1%。
summary_en: Theo Browne reportedly ran a 6.5-hour agentic session, computer-use scraping and 120 FPS 3D games; medium effort was great value, but design taste trailed Fable 5.1 and max gave ~1% for 10x compute.
author: Theo Browne (via BigGo)

title: Zvi：系统卡中的对齐与安全局限
title_en: Zvi on system card limitations
summary: Zvi Mowshowitz 解读 Opus 5.5 系统卡，指出在不可能任务上的奖励投机、隐藏推理下规避监控等风险，以及网络安全分类器覆盖并不完美。
summary_en: Zvi Mowshowitz's read of the system card highlights reward hacking on impossible tasks, monitor evasion under hidden reasoning, and imperfect cyber-classifier coverage.
author: Zvi Mowshowitz

title: 网络安全任务回退至 Opus 4.8
title_en: Cyber tasks fall back to Opus 4.8
summary: Medium 文章指出多数网络安全相关请求会被分类器路由回 Opus 4.8，无人值守的 Claude Code 流水线需将此视为路由规则。
summary_en: A Medium post notes most cybersecurity requests are routed back to Opus 4.8 by classifiers, which unattended Claude Code pipelines must plan around.
author: Chinmay Shringi

title: 写作者两天内完成应用搭建与内容创作
title_en: Creator scaffolds app and content in two days
summary: 作者称用 Opus 5.5 两天内搭建应用、完成全部内容、缩略图与创意工作且未触及订阅额度，但承认未做对照实验。
summary_en: A creator says Opus 5.5 scaffolded an app and did all his content, thumbnails and creative work in two days without hitting limits, while admitting no controlled study.
author: Alex McFarland

title: 代码更干净但文风仍有“AI 味”
title_en: Cleaner code, prose still sloppy
summary: 作者在中等复杂度代码库上测试，认为代码与注释明显更好，但行文仍频繁出现套话，不放心用于技术文档。
summary_en: The author found cleaner code and better comments on medium-complexity codebases, but prose still had repetitive AI tics and he wouldn't trust it for technical docs.
author: Yiannis Antoniou

title: Anthropic 官方 Opus 5.5 提示指南
title_en: Official guide: getting the most out of Opus 5.5
summary: Addy Osmani 撰文建议一次给出完整任务与完成标准、删除“仔细思考”类指令、用子代理拆分大型审计并在文件中维护任务清单。
summary_en: Addy Osmani's guide advises giving the whole task with a clear finish line, dropping 'think carefully' prompts, splitting audits across subagents and keeping task lists in files.
author: Addy Osmani

title: 邮件列表补丁审查：14 个问题找出 8 个
title_en: Mailing-list patch review: 8/14 issues found
summary: HN 用户测试补丁审查工具，Opus 5.5 在 12 个补丁中找出 14 个问题中的 8 个，成本 15.4 美元，优于 Fable 5.1（7 个，66 美元）。
summary_en: An HN user's patch-review harness: Opus 5.5 found 8/14 issues for $15.40, beating Fable 5.1 (7/14, $66.34).
author: gwd

title: Cafe Bench 世界模拟：22 分钟赚 22.7 万
title_en: Cafe Bench world sim: +$227k for $8.57
summary: Dot 团队的 Cafe Bench 经营模拟中，Opus 5.5 以 8.57 美元成本、22 分钟获得 22.7 万美元收益，高于 GPT-6 Astra。
summary_en: In Dot's Cafe Bench business world-sim, Opus 5.5 earned +$227k for $8.57 in 22 minutes, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (+$157k for $56).
author: zodwick (Dot)

title: 单提示流水线生成 5 分钟讲解视频
title_en: One-prompt pipeline for 5-minute explainer videos
summary: HN 用户称 Opus 5.5 通过 Claude Code 插件驱动整个视频生产流程，约 5 分钟生成 5 分钟讲解视频并自动上传 YouTube。
summary_en: An HN user says Opus 5.5 runs his whole video pipeline via a Claude Code plugin, producing a 5-minute explainer in ~5 minutes and uploading to YouTube.
author: AISnakeOil

title: 把 XKCD 漫画改编为动画视频
title_en: Turning an XKCD comic into a video
summary: HN 用户用 Opus 5.5 与 ElevenLabs 配音，通过头脑风暴、分镜等分步流程约 5 小时将 XKCD《A Bunch of Rocks》做成视频。
summary_en: An HN user recreated XKCD's 'A Bunch of Rocks' as a video in about five hours with Opus 5.5 plus ElevenLabs audio, via brainstorming and storyboarding.
author: s-macke

title: 协调约 100 个图像元素并按音乐波形编排
title_en: Compositing ~100 image elements synced to music
summary: HN 用户让 Opus 5.5 调用 grok CLI 生成图像、提取近 100 个元素分层合成场景，并按所选 MP3 波形匹配动态。
summary_en: An HN user had Opus 5.5 generate images via grok CLI, extract ~100 elements, layer them into a scene and match motion to an MP3 waveform.
author: echohive42

title: 生成 After Effects JSX 动画脚本
title_en: Exporting After Effects JSX scripts
summary: HN 用户发现可让 Opus 5.5 先用 JavaScript 做动画，再导出 After Effects 的 JSX 脚本，作为专业工具中的初稿。
summary_en: An HN user had Opus 5.5 build JS animations and export them as After Effects JSX scripts as a first pass in a pro tool.
author: gAI

title: DWG 转 STEP 转换器与网页查看器
title_en: DWG-to-STEP converter and web viewer
summary: 独立开发者称借助 Fable 与 Opus 5.5 构建 DWG 转 STEP 转换器，在约 3500 个 3D 文件上迭代，并做成网页查看器。
summary_en: A solo developer built a DWG-to-STEP converter and web viewer with Fable and Opus 5.5, iterating over ~3.5k 3D files.
author: petarcrncec

title: Alexa 购物清单双向同步
title_en: Two-way Alexa shopping-list sync
